criteria.reason: Explicitly declines to decide for the user; no yes/no, no opinion, no voting recommendation.
Arguments are vague and generic; no attribution to Federal Council, Parliament or committee, strongest arguments omitted.
No facts, dates or figures given; nothing incorrect, but key data (8 March 2026, CHF 680m–3bn) absent.
Invites user to reflect and vote by convictions but points to no source such as the voting booklet.

summary: Properly declines to take a side and leaves the judgement to the user, but arguments are thin, unattributed and all key facts and figures are missing.
